title: The Pin
concept: A pin freezes an enemy piece in place. It cannot move because something more valuable is right behind it on the same line.
tip: Line up your rook, bishop or queen so an enemy piece is stuck in front of its king or queen.

feedback.correct: Correct! The piece is pinned — it cannot move without exposing something more valuable behind it!
feedback.hint: Line up your piece so an enemy piece is stuck in front of something more valuable.
feedback.reveal: The pin places your piece on the line between an enemy piece and something valuable behind it.
